discovery_method_note: WebSearch session budget was exhausted early (shared session) and search engines (DuckDuckGo, Brave, Qwant, Bing) served bot challenges or junk; discovery used retailer product sitemaps (keyword scan of product URLs, up to 80 sitemap files per site) and retailer site-search pages. Several Shopify stores answered HTTP 429 'Verifying your connection' on this egress (not bypassed).

queries: product-sitemap URL scan with regex 'fructo|fruit-sugar|inulin|yolk|egg-powder|cream-powder|dried-cream|heavy-cream|powdered-cream' plus Vietnamese slugs 'long-do-trung|bot-kem|kem-sua|duong-trai-cay' on beemart.vn, pharmacity.vn, hasaki.vn, winmart.vn, kingfoodmart.com, nhathuoclongchau.com.vn, guardian.com.vn, bachhoaxanh.com
sources_tried: beemart.vn (baking-ingredient retailer) - 7.3k URLs scanned: 'bột kem béo' non-dairy creamers (Luave MT 35, Krub O), 'bột kem trứng' custard powders, 'Bột kem sữa Cremyco Puratos 5kg' (pastry cream mix), 'bột kem sữa chua' (yogurt powder), 'lòng đỏ trứng vịt muối dạng bột' (salted DUCK egg yolk powder, cured flavouring) - all rejected; heavy cream is liquid
pharmacity.vn (pharmacy chain) - 34k URLs scanned: articles only, no products
hasaki.vn (health & beauty) - sitemaps partly scanned: hair-dye 'bột kem' products only
winmart.vn (supermarket) - sitemap holds categories only; kingfoodmart.com - no product URLs
nhathuoclongchau.com.vn (pharmacy chain) - HTTP 403, inconclusive
guardian.com.vn - HTTP 403, inconclusive
bachhoaxanh.com (supermarket) - not readable (empty response)
shopee.vn / lazada.vn / tiki.vn (marketplaces) - not used
CRP.notes: Only non-dairy creamers and custard/pastry cream mixes found (rejected types).
